title: Integrated Bayesian / Sequential Monte Carlo Methodology for Re-estimating the MH370 Impact and Wreckage Location
objective: Estimate model-averaged PDFs for first water contact, effective impact/acoustic source, and principal wreckage resting location by propagating uncertainty from pre-impact flight evidence through EOF dynamics and independent post-impact evidence.
core_principle: Sample the physically feasible manifold first; let observations supply likelihood rather than selecting a preferred narrative in advance.
target: p(impact/wreckage location | radar + SATCOM + aircraft dynamics + fuel + EOF + hydroacoustics + debris/drift + satellite imagery + underwater-search results)

state.impact: Psi={r_contact,t_contact,m_I,v_I,attitude,angular state,power state,energy-deposition history,breakup state,debris initial conditions,wreckage latent variables}

stages: Calibrate component models on external/known events where possible.
Adaptive SMC from a fixed radar-derived initialisation epoch to 00:11 using radar/BTO/BFO/received-power/fuel/performance evidence.
Use the complete 00:11 posterior as EOF prior; assimilate 00:19 BTO/BFO/reboot evidence here; treat fuel-exhaustion causation as a model hypothesis.
Propagate through a time- and space-distributed water-impact episode, including powered/unpowered alternatives, fuel exhaustion as a hitting-time event, breakup and initial debris.
Conditionally evaluate hydroacoustic, debris/drift, imagery and underwater-search likelihoods from the common impact state.
Fuse evidence once at the common impact state, model-average across EOF hypotheses, and marginalise to contact/source/wreckage PDFs.

sampling.speed: Do not use one global uniform Mach prior. Sample speed conditional on altitude, mass, configuration and atmosphere; permit slower feasible speeds while enforcing stall/min-drag and VMO/MMO.
sampling.altitude: Use temporally coherent altitude dynamics. Preserve low-altitude support at 00:11 using a descent-onset/mode mixture and/or stratified/bridge proposal, not independent 0-40,000 ft draws at all times.
sampling.bfo0011: Infer vertical speed jointly with heading, speed and BFO bias/error. The 00:11 value is consistent with level flight but does not uniquely require it.
sampling.bfo0019: Assimilate terminal data only in the EOF stage with OCXO/power-interruption hypotheses marginalised.

key_cautions: Do not multiply separately normalised acoustic and drift posteriors without removing their common impact prior.
Do not equate first contact, acoustic source and main-wreckage location.
Do not make non-detections hard exclusions without detection models.
Treat searched seabed with spatial probability of detection, not a binary mask.
Treat satellite imagery with acquisition geometry and false-positive/look-elsewhere modelling.
